claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.mixed_mode
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines always-on passive protection, an activated Magic action toggle, and a death-triggered post-mortem state. The current magic-item surface only allows one mechanics family at a time: passive or activation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While wearing this ring, you are immune ..." / "You can take a Magic action ..." / "If you die while wearing the ring, your soul enters it..."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: block_information_magic
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive protection is not resistance, condition immunity, or targeting denial. It specifically blocks magic that reads thoughts or reveals lie/alignment/creature-type information.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine whether you are lying, know your alignment, or know your creature type"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: telepathy_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item regulates telepathic communication in two directions: outside creatures may communicate only with the wearer's permission, but a housed soul can always communicate with the wearer.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Creatures can telepathically communicate with you only if you allow it." / "A wearer can't prevent this telepathic communication."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_soul_vessel
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The death-triggered soul-storage behavior creates persistent occupant state on the item and grants a new communication channel while that state persists.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you die while wearing the ring, your soul enters it, unless it already houses a soul. ... As long as your soul is in the ring, you can telepathically communicate with any creature wearing it."
